title: AG60166: Off-Road Vehicle Engineering
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Engine components and basic engine nomenclature, IC engine classification, Air
standard cycle and fuel cycle analysis for diesel and dual combustion or
limited pressure cycle, Difference between actual and fuel air cycles in diesel
engines, Combustion in CI engines, Alternate fuels for CI engines, Engine
friction and lubrication, Engine cooling, Supercharging, Dual fuel and
multifuel engines, Exhaust emissions and its measurement, Testing of farm
engines, Performance parameter and characteristics.
